candidate_build.note: The probe ran against a verification build of the same sources with inlining and interprocedural constant propagation disabled, because the release build inlines most natives and leaves no call site for an entry hook to observe. Inlining is semantics-preserving; the only build difference is that optimisation.

comparison.basis: reachability only; the native's return value is not comparable
comparison.return_comparability_reason: retail 0x00497E70 copies the caller's 0xA8-byte context, dispatches the registered render method, marks the context installed and then returns the incremented install counter; the port performs the copy and the bookkeeping but returns void, so EAX is not a comparable result. Reachability is the meaningful criterion.
comparison.note: The retail body does not write EAX, so it returns nothing and the observed value belongs to its callee. This native is compared on reachability, not on a return value.

limitations: Retail and candidate are captured sequentially because both hold a single-instance mutex; the two runs attach at different points of level load, so call indices and call counts do not correspond.
The probe classifies arguments and return values as null, a small exact value, or a pointer. Values behind pointers are not read, so this does not evaluate the data a native computes.
This report establishes that the native was reached in both images and returned the same class of value for the configured level run. It does not establish behavioural parity or any side effect.
